AIR CONDmONING AIR CONDITIONING UNIT
AIR CONDITIONING UNIT
ON-VEHICLE INSPECTION
INSPECT FOR LEAKAGE OF REFRIGERANT
(a) Remove the glove compartment door (See page 80-79),
(b) Remove the blower unit.
(c) Using a gas leak detector, check for leakage of refrigerant.
If there is leakage, check the tightening torque at the joints or check the evaporator, expansion valve, A/C
tube and 0-rings.
